g.text: Three weather instruments (sections, not to the same scale)
A: rain enters the 127 mm rim, the funnel channels it into the
bottle, and the glass measure gives rainfall depth in mm: a rain
B: a dry bulb beside a wet bulb kept moist by a muslin wick; the
wet-bulb depression, read with a table, gives relative humidity.
C: the cups turn the spindle in the wind; the counter, by
calibration, gives wind speed in m/s: a cup anemometer.
